params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch strictly removes commented-out code sections and unnecessary comments, directly addressing the SonarQube warning about commented-out code. There are no unrelated or unnecessary changes to the functional code, variable names, or logic. The edits are minimal and focused solely on deleting commented-out code and comments, which improves readability without affecting functionality.
